absolute_error_spearman.definition: Spearman rank correlation of |E-E_ref| over jointly completed, reference-valid tasks.

agreement.definition: agreement(i,j;task)=1 iff both energies exist and |E_i-E_j| <= tau_task; aggregate is the fraction over jointly completed tasks. Agreement is evidence of consistency, not correctness.

campaign_identity.definition: Every normalized solver record carries a campaign. Explicit G-39 campaign metadata is retained; pre-campaign records receive the deterministic label legacy:<solution-file-family>. Solver statistics, agreement, similarity, and ladders never pool across campaigns.

failure_set_jaccard.definition: Jaccard similarity of solver failure sets (miss union indeterminate) over jointly attempted reference-valid tasks; an empty joint failure union emits null with status no_joint_failures.

g39_record_correction.definition: G-39 corrected 27 original ran-and-failed G-31 records, plus two diamond race records, from never-ran flags to attempted failed/timeout metadata without changing energies or reasons. Reconciliation is reported in diagnostics.record_correction.

governing_ci_annotation.definition: A zero-width multi-family governing success-rate interval whose success indicator is constant is annotated degenerate_constant_outcome.

graded_residual.definition: r(solver, task) = |E-E_ref| / tau_task for completed runs.

not_attempted.definition: A record is coverage-only only when harness_status=not_attempted, attempted=false, and no runtime, exit, launch, traceback, or execution-bearing reason is present. Contradictory records are data errors and hard-fail ingest.

outcome.definition: success iff a usable returned energy satisfies |E-E_ref| <= tau_task; miss iff it exceeds tau_task; indeterminate iff no usable energy was returned. Scored only on reference-valid tasks.

panel_success_rate.definition: successes divided by attempts, including indeterminate attempts, across the observed solver panel for a reference-valid task.

public_task.definition: A public task has curation_tier != test and joins to a committed problem-instance task_uuid; unjoinable attempts are never public.
public_task.spec_section: METRICS_SPEC_v1.md sections 1 and 3; ME-2 audit D1/D3

reference_uncertainty.definition: Maximum Hartree value over all occurrences in task, requirements, and features of reference_energy_uncertainty (using its stored units), reference_energy_standard_error (Hartree), and reference_energy_standard_error_hartree (Hartree). The cross-check field features.qsz_afqmc_standard_error_hartree is deliberately excluded because it describes AFQMC cross-check uncertainty, not the local FCI reference anchor.

size_band.definition: Size is stored NORB with no spin doubling, read consistently from features.num_orbitals, features.hubbard_num_sites, independent_parameters.num_sites, or independent_parameters.num_spatial_orbitals; bands are norb_le8, norb_9_16, norb_17_32, norb_33_64, norb_65_128, or norb_ge129.

solver_resource_ladders.definition: Declared solver members are ordered by a populated resource knob. For every earlier/later pair, nestedness violations count tasks where the earlier member succeeds and the later member does not over jointly-attempted reference-valid tasks.

solver_spread.definition: Maximum minus minimum energy over completed panel results for a task.

stratified_outcome_rate.definition: Per-solver success, miss, and indeterminate counts and rates within full-cross family/tier/size/threshold strata plus across-family size-band, tier, and global marginal pools; each reports an instance interval and a governing family interval only when at least two families are present.

task_class.definition: solved_by_all when every attempt succeeds, solved_by_none when no attempt succeeds, and contested otherwise; panel-composition-dependent.

threshold_provenance.definition: All thresholds are read from committed task requirements after the G-38 O19 per-site regeneration (commit 6bbdb54); the metric layer does not derive or alter thresholds.

attempt_disposition.identity: all committed records = scored + not_attempted + excluded categories

definition.definition: Every normalized solver record carries a campaign. Explicit G-39 campaign metadata is retained; pre-campaign records receive the deterministic label legacy:<solution-file-family>. Solver statistics, agreement, similarity, and ladders never pool across campaigns.

public_definition.definition: A public task has curation_tier != test and joins to a committed problem-instance task_uuid; unjoinable attempts are never public.
public_definition.spec_section: METRICS_SPEC_v1.md sections 1 and 3; ME-2 audit D1/D3

record_correction.identity: all 27 original G-39 corrections are attempted; reference-valid records reappear as indeterminate outcomes and other records retain their normal section-3 disposition
